# orrery COSMOS CE plugin — one fleet, one plugin: per-vehicle targets
# (SAT_CHIEF, SAT_DEPUTY), each with its own gs_tcp interface.
#
# cmd/tlm definitions are AUTO-GENERATED by codegen/eds2cosmos from the
# mission EDS (never hand-edit cmd_tlm/*). The interface is ONE logical link
# with TWO TCP streams, mirroring the vehicle: telemetry arrives on the beacon
# port (5050), commands leave on the uplink port (5051). Tcpip client
# interfaces take (hostname, write_port, read_port, write_timeout,
# read_timeout): write_port = commands out, read_port = telemetry in.
# Both timeouts are explicit — a nil write_timeout draws a WARN every connect.
# Length framing comes straight from the CCSDS header field:
#   length_bit_offset=32 (byte 4), 16 bits BE, total = field + 7.

VARIABLE sat_chief_target_name SAT_CHIEF
VARIABLE gs_tcp_host host.docker.internal
VARIABLE gs_tcp_port 5050
VARIABLE gs_tcp_cmd_port 5051

TARGET SAT_CHIEF <%= sat_chief_target_name %>
# cmd/tlm defs ship in the gem under targets/SAT_CHIEF/cmd_tlm/ and are picked
# up automatically by CE v6 (no FILE keywords in plugin.txt).

INTERFACE GS_TCP_INT openc3/interfaces/tcpip_client_interface.py <%= gs_tcp_host %> <%= gs_tcp_cmd_port %> <%= gs_tcp_port %> 10.0 10.0
  MAP_TARGET <%= sat_chief_target_name %>
  # READ/WRITE: CCSDS length-framed stream (field @bit 32, 16 bits big-endian,
  # total octets = field + 7; fill on write). No per-packet protocol code.
  PROTOCOL READ openc3/interfaces/protocols/length_protocol.py 32 16 7 1 BIG_ENDIAN 0 nil 65535 False None
  PROTOCOL WRITE openc3/interfaces/protocols/length_protocol.py 32 16 7 1 BIG_ENDIAN 0 nil 65535 True None

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Fleet: the SAME generated defs, twice. Vehicle deputy (instance 1)
# speaks byte-identical packets on its own port pair - and that is exactly
# the collision this design plans for: packet IDs share ONE namespace inside COSMOS's
# router, so target identity must be carried by the interface, via explicit
# MAP_TARGET, on BOTH sides (a packet id matching two targets' defs is only
# decidable by which interface it arrived on). Satellite identity in the
# ground system = target name -> interface -> port pair -> vehicle.
VARIABLE sat_deputy_target_name SAT_DEPUTY
VARIABLE gs_tcp2_host host.docker.internal
VARIABLE gs_tcp2_port 5052
VARIABLE gs_tcp2_cmd_port 5053

TARGET SAT_DEPUTY <%= sat_deputy_target_name %>

INTERFACE GS_TCP2_INT openc3/interfaces/tcpip_client_interface.py <%= gs_tcp2_host %> <%= gs_tcp2_cmd_port %> <%= gs_tcp2_port %> 10.0 10.0
  MAP_TARGET <%= sat_deputy_target_name %>
  PROTOCOL READ openc3/interfaces/protocols/length_protocol.py 32 16 7 1 BIG_ENDIAN 0 nil 65535 False None
  PROTOCOL WRITE openc3/interfaces/protocols/length_protocol.py 32 16 7 1 BIG_ENDIAN 0 nil 65535 True None

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Truth: one TELEMETRY-ONLY interface per vehicle, born instance-aware.
# Basilisk truth reaches COSMOS through the per-vehicle truth gateway (sim/
# truth_gateway.py): ZMQ :5590+20N in, stamped+length-framed TCP :5150+2N
# out. Ground-owned framing (4-byte header, total = field + 4), NOT CCSDS -
# this stream never crosses the satellite boundary, and its targets have NO
# command defs at all: the truth side has no actuators, so a truth command
# cannot even be formed in the ground system. See docs/data_provenance.md.
VARIABLE truth_chief_target_name TRUTH_CHIEF
VARIABLE truth_chief_port 5150
VARIABLE truth_deputy_target_name TRUTH_DEPUTY
VARIABLE truth_deputy_port 5152

TARGET TRUTH_CHIEF <%= truth_chief_target_name %>

INTERFACE TRUTH_CHIEF_INT openc3/interfaces/tcpip_client_interface.py <%= gs_tcp_host %> <%= truth_chief_port %> <%= truth_chief_port %> 10.0 10.0
  MAP_TARGET <%= truth_chief_target_name %>
  PROTOCOL READ openc3/interfaces/protocols/length_protocol.py 16 16 4 1 BIG_ENDIAN 0 nil 65535 False None
  PROTOCOL WRITE openc3/interfaces/protocols/length_protocol.py 16 16 4 1 BIG_ENDIAN 0 nil 65535 True None

TARGET TRUTH_DEPUTY <%= truth_deputy_target_name %>

INTERFACE TRUTH_DEPUTY_INT openc3/interfaces/tcpip_client_interface.py <%= gs_tcp_host %> <%= truth_deputy_port %> <%= truth_deputy_port %> 10.0 10.0
  MAP_TARGET <%= truth_deputy_target_name %>
  PROTOCOL READ openc3/interfaces/protocols/length_protocol.py 16 16 4 1 BIG_ENDIAN 0 nil 65535 False None
  PROTOCOL WRITE openc3/interfaces/protocols/length_protocol.py 16 16 4 1 BIG_ENDIAN 0 nil 65535 True None
